meta_description: Mullally Electrical Contractors bring 20+ years' expertise to Liverpool homes and businesses. NICEIC certified, emergency repairs, rewires, and installations. Call now for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault in your Liverpool home? We're out to fault-finding and repairs in under an hour, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full rewires, we handle every electrical job with care and precision.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, or no power at all? We diagnose and fix faults fast, with parts on the van. Available 24/7 to get your home safe again.

services.title: Rewires & Circuit Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We pull out dated cables and install modern, safe circuits to today's Building Regulations. Includes full testing and certification.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: New boiler installation or control upgrades? We handle all electrical connections, testing, and commissioning to ensure your heating runs safely and efficiently.

services.title: Consumer Unit Installation
services.desc: Upgrading your fuse box to a modern consumer unit reduces fire risk and adds safety features. We install, test, and issue full certification.

services.title: Lighting & Socket Installation
services.desc: New lights, extra sockets, or a full kitchen refit? We design circuits for your needs, install neatly, and test everything to keep your family safe.

services.title: Electrical Safety Certificates
services.desc: Moving house or renewing a tenancy? We issue EICR safety reports and corrective work to satisfy landlords, insurers, and buyers.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Liverpool homes honest, reliable electrical work.
about_para_1: Mullally Electrical has been serving Liverpool households and small businesses for over two decades. Founded on the principle of doing the job right first time, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing faults accurately, and fixing them without fuss or hidden charges. Every member of our team is NICEIC certified and insured.
about_para_2: Homeowners come back to us because we treat their home like our own — we explain what's wrong, show you what we're fixing, and don't upsell unnecessary work. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, you'll get the same friendly, professional service and a fair price every time.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete nightmare with our electrics — house was showing faults left and right. Mullally came out, did a full inspection, and rewired the lot to a proper standard. Took two days, fair price, and they cleared up after themselves. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: 3am on a Sunday and our boiler cut out. Called Mullally expecting to wait hours, but they answered straight away and had an engineer round before breakfast. Turned out to be a dodgy electrical feed. Fixed it for a fraction of what I thought it'd cost. Lifesavers.
reviews.author: Michelle P.

reviews.text: Very honest about what needs doing and what doesn't. Came to do a socket install and spotted an old fusebox that was a fire risk. Gave me options, took their advice, and they did the whole upgrade. Professional, friendly, no pressure. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert K.
